name: mixed_v2
decided_by: maintainer decisions 2026-10-26: the brief 'Next Experiment: Mixed Calibration 2x Independent Design' (2x = 1x supporting + 1x fluid by realized calibration positions, every P10.2 axis in the fluid half) and its review 'Mixed Calibration 2x -- Final Design Corrections' of commit 6e2887ca: (1) fluid_uesp == supporting_uesp EXACTLY, by the positions the operators compute on, through a declared deterministic whole-unit rule, never by labels, weights or rounding; (2) this round covers 2x only -- 4x is outside its budget, authorization, implementation and every automatic flow. This file is the agent's $0 design; it authorizes nothing
question: Under D4-Augmented's recovery and evaluation exactly, does the Top-1 of a formal D1 full search calibrated on one mixed profile (supporting + fluid over all five P10.2 axes, exactly equal realized scored positions) recover better static fluid correctness than D4 Top-1?

supersedes.status: SUPERSEDED: kept byte-unchanged as the superseded design; never searched, never a calibration input
supersedes.why: calib.s0m_mix_2x@v1 realized fluid 71,216 against supporting 70,401 scored positions (50.29 : 49.71): its nearest-prefix rule balanced only to within half a unit per supporting cell, which the maintainer rejected. Its 4x profile is out of this round's scope

pool._why: the verified teacher-native pool historical D4's profiles were drawn from: 506 static fluid units, 13 interactive episodes and 6,020 supporting units, every item <= 8,192 rendered tokens. No new teacher data: the brief forbids generating it this round

fluid.quota: dose's fluid nominal / 5 per axis; a static axis splits it equally over its generators (one cell per generator); the interactive axis is ONE cell pooling both generators, so its quota is not doubled by the at-least-one-unit rule; within a cell the rule families are interleaved, so n units span min(n, families) families; unchanged from v1, so the fluid half is v1's unit for unit
fluid._interactive: an episode (unit_id) is taken or left whole, every turn item with it; base_pool_v1 has 13 episodes from 3 calibration rule families (8.3k-27.0k scored positions each), so at these doses the at-least-one-episode rule, not the quota, sets the interactive size

supporting.quota: the target is the fluid half's REALIZED scored positions T, an integer; the four cells' quotas are T // 4 each, the remainder T mod 4 one position each to the first cells in the order listed. Each cell takes whole units from the front of its seed-keyed order while the next unit still fits its quota (running total + unit <= quota) and stops at the first unit that does not fit, skipping nothing; at least one unit
supporting._why: the same four supporting groups historical D4's profiles drew (knowledge-dependent: learned math procedure, multi-hop and evidence reading); code and tool_calling stay out as they did in D4's calibration, and no closed-book factual QA source exists among the verified teacher-native data

balance.closure: the residual R = T - (the four prefixes' positions) is closed by the FEWEST whole units, k = 1, 2 or 3, taken from the units the four cells have not yet taken, whose scored positions sum to exactly R. Candidates are read in ONE canonical sequence: the cells' remaining orders interleaved rank by rank, cells in the order listed; among the exact sets of the fewest units, the one whose last member comes earliest in that sequence, then whose earlier members come earliest (build_mixed_profiles.close_exact)
balance.reads: scored positions only: no result, score, evaluation outcome, correctness or other length; nothing is cut, repeated, copied or padded, and every unit (an episode with every turn) is taken or left whole
balance.infeasible: if no set of at most 3 units closes R exactly (for instance a residual smaller than every remaining unit), or the prefixes already exceed T, the build writes the closest gaps one and two units reach and stops: no profile, the prefixes are not revisited, and the ratio is not relaxed
balance.equality: fluid == supporting is asserted on the positions the operators compute on, counted through the core's own contracts: the forward baseline's position policy on the TOKEN axis (FFN, RESIDUAL_WIDTH and ATTENTION statistics) and the PREDICTION axis (DEPTH KL), and DEPTH's domain_balanced_score over the domain map it builds from the items' labels (1/2 per half); no tolerance
balance.realized: for calib.s0m_mix_2x@v2: T = 71,216, prefixes 67,690, R = 3,526, closed by 2 units (no single unit has 3,526 positions); see the feasibility audit

2x.role: the formal search's profile, and the only profile this design builds

out_of_scope.4x: maintainer decision 2026-10-26: not in this round's budget, authorization, implementation or any automatic flow. It may stay in the research documents as a future option; no profile is built for it, no cost is allocated, no paid resource is prepared, and no preregistered result starts it. Whether to run 4x is the maintainer's decision after the formal 2x result

labels.subtype: fluid: the item's P10.2 axis; supporting: its source group
labels._why: DEPTH's objective is an unweighted mean over domain labels of an unweighted mean over subtypes of per-item KL (equal_subtype_then_equal_domain/v1). With the half as the domain, DEPTH weights supporting and fluid 1/2 each and every fluid axis 1/10; with the historical axis-as-domain labels it would weight supporting 1/6. FFN, RESIDUAL_WIDTH and ATTENTION pool their statistics over scored positions, so the realized position split is their weight

seed_derivation: uint32_be(sha256('stage0.calibration_volume.mixed_v1|draw|1')[:4]) mod 2**31: v1's ONE draw, kept -- the same seed-keyed orders in every cell, so the fluid half is v1's and only the supporting half's stopping rule changes; never re-drawn
sample_rule: stratified sampling with exact balance: per cell an order that interleaves its rule families (families in a seed-keyed order, each family's units in a seed-keyed order, one unit per family per round), whole units taken from the front (at least one); a fluid cell until its quota of scored positions is met; then each supporting cell to the prefix that fits its integer share of the fluid half's REALIZED positions, and the residual closed exactly by the fewest whole units (at most 3) earliest in the cells' remaining orders interleaved (build_mixed_profiles.py)

inherited: dev_v1 and final evaluation families (generator family split)

d4_augmented_members.what: every session D4-Augmented trained or validated on: E1's 2.96M training prefix and 16 validation sequences, and the fluid increment's admitted sessions; a pool unit is excluded when it shares a session id, a source id or a prompt key with any of them
d4_augmented_members._why: the recovery data must not double as the new arm's calibration data. The base pool predates the 2.96M rung: 1,713 of its 6,020 supporting units share a session, source or prompt with D4-Augmented's training or validation sets, and D4 Top-1's own calibration drew 8 of them (base_d4: 8 items, 7,457 of its 203,726 scored positions; rh_d4: 3 of those 8). No fluid unit of the pool is a member

exclusions.eval_set: eval-set-1 held-out units, by the frozen Stage-2 isolation rules R0-R9 (stages.reasoning_data.isolation_check.check_pool, historical pool); a unit an R1 or R2 check flags is excluded

search.declared_change: the forward baseline's free variable 'calibration profile per operator' has ONE value: every operator calibrates on the mixed 2x profile (calib.s0m_mix_2x@v2). The beam tree is then 4 + 12 + 12 + 6 = 34 expansions instead of the historical two-profile 8 + 48 + 24 + 12 = 92. Operator order (all 24 orders reachable), beam.delayed_prune@v1 width 6 warmup 1, beam.pareto_multi_objective@v2, state_eval@v1, positions.supervised_target_v1@v1, reference_topk_tail_v1 K=200, micro-batch 3, length_sorted_v1 and scored_v1 are unchanged
search._execution: the bit-identical execution options historical D4's search ran with (search_record.json :: execution)
